environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with NO action overrides (all rules in default BLOCK mode including SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS which inspects all query string parameters using the built-in SQLi detection engine with sensitivity level HIGH). The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress beyond port 443 to specific AWS service endpoints (preventing out-of-band data exfiltration via DNS/HTTP). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite DB is on an EFS mount with encryption at rest.

waf_rules.note: SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS rule inspects all query string key-value pairs

config.network_egress: restricted to 443 on AWS service endpoints only (VPC endpoints for S3, ECR, CloudWatch)
